	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_POL.530"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.530.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.530.a executed"
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_signed
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_open
			clear_variable = COLDWAR_POL_offer_casaroli_commission_party
		}
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_casaroli_commission } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_POL_casaroli_commission }
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}

# SOV decision Fraternal Assistance: letter to Poland
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_POL.701
	title = COLDWAR_POL.701.t
	desc = COLDWAR_POL.701.d
	picture = GFX_politics_dictatorship

	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = { original_tag = POL }

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_POL.701"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.701.a
		trigger = { country_exists = SOV }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.701.a executed"
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2 NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = yes } }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_1
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3 NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = yes } }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4 NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = yes } }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_6 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_6
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 3 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.701.b
		trigger = { country_exists = SOV }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.701.b executed"
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.701.c
		trigger = { country_exists = SOV }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.701.c executed"
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.701.e
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					country_exists = SOV
				}
			}
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.701.e executed"
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}

# SOV decision Cut Oil Deliveries: notice to Poland
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_POL.702
	title = COLDWAR_POL.702.t
	desc = COLDWAR_POL.702.d
	picture = GFX_oil_refinery

	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = { original_tag = POL }

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_POL.702"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.702.a
		trigger = {
			country_exists = SOV
			SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_oil_cut }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.702.a executed"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_debt_p5_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_debt_change = 5 } COLDWAR_POL_change_debt = yes }
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.702.b
		trigger = {
			country_exists = SOV
			SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_oil_cut }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.702.b executed"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_unrest_p5_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_unrest_change = 5 } COLDWAR_POL_change_unrest = yes }
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.702.c
		trigger = {
			country_exists = SOV
			SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_oil_cut }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.702.c executed"
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_1 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_1
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_6
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.702.e
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					country_exists = SOV
					SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_oil_cut }
				}
			}
		}

# SOV decision Offer to Reschedule the Rouble Debt: offer to Poland
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_POL.703
	title = COLDWAR_POL.703.t
	desc = COLDWAR_POL.703.d
	picture = GFX_banking_crisis

	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = { original_tag = POL }

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_POL.703"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.703.a
		trigger = {
			COLDWAR_POL_relations_clear_SOV = yes
			SOV = { COLDWAR_POL_has_offer_with_SOV = yes }
			check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_POL_debt value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.703.a executed"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_deferral_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_debt_change = -10 } COLDWAR_POL_change_debt = yes country_event = { id = COLDWAR_POL.801 days = 365 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_1 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_1
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_6
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_POL.704 } } }
		ai_chance = { base = 3 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.703.b
		trigger = {
			COLDWAR_POL_relations_clear_SOV = yes
			SOV = { COLDWAR_POL_has_offer_with_SOV = yes }
			check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_POL_debt value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.703.b executed"
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.703.c
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					COLDWAR_POL_relations_clear_SOV = yes
					SOV = { COLDWAR_POL_has_offer_with_SOV = yes }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_POL_debt value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.703.c executed"
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	trigger = { original_tag = POL }

	}

		name = COLDWAR_POL.706.a

			country_exists = USA

		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.706.a executed"

		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.706.b

			country_exists = USA
			USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_us_sanctions }

		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.706.b executed"

		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_unrest_change = 5 } COLDWAR_POL_change_unrest = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2 NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = yes } }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_1
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3 NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = yes } }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4 NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = yes } }

				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
			}
		}

				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
			}
		}
		else_if = {

			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_6
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 2 }
	}

	option = {

			USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_us_sanctions }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.706.c executed"
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

			NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_under_sanctions = yes }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.715.a executed"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_deferral_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_debt_change = -10 } COLDWAR_POL_change_debt = yes country_event = { id = COLDWAR_POL.801 days = 365 } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_fra_repay_tt
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_POL.716 days = 730 } }
		ai_chance = { base = 2 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.715.b
		trigger = {
			COLDWAR_POL_relations_clear_FRA = yes
			check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_POL_debt value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_under_sanctions = yes }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.715.b executed"
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.715.c
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					COLDWAR_POL_relations_clear_FRA = yes
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_POL_debt value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_under_sanctions = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.715.c executed"
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}

# POL scope: start of the repayment to France
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_POL.716
	title = COLDWAR_POL.716.t
	desc = COLDWAR_POL.716.d
	picture = GFX_banking_crisis

	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = { original_tag = POL }

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_POL.716"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_POL.716.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_POL.716.a executed"
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_POL_fra_reschedule_repay value = 1 days = 1825 } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_fra_repay_tt
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}
